summary: --print-command prints the preset's vllm serve process as a docker run script
compatibility: No user action required; nothing changes for a normal start.
details: docker run --rm -e PRESET=<preset> <image> --print-command prints the vllm serve process behind the preset as a shell script: a docker run command with every environment variable the launcher sets and the vLLM options as the container command, which keeps the image's CUDA/NCCL bootstrap and skips the profile launcher. IMAGE=<image> GPUS=0,1 PORT=8000 bash <script> starts it.

FP4-CSF checkpoints in the Hugging Face layout are named by repository and --revision with the execution-time options (--quantization modelopt_mixed --load-format instanttensor), so vLLM downloads the pinned revision itself. Presets with the external LMCache tier print their CACHE_MODE=vram form.
